proc main (): eff loaded integer :=
  let strong i: pointer = create(Ivalignof('signed int'), 'signed int') in
  let strong a_512: loaded integer = bound(pure(Specified(0))) in
  store('signed int', i, conv_loaded_int('signed int', a_512)) ;
  save while_513: unit (i: pointer:= i) in
    let strong a_515: loaded integer =
      bound(
        let weak (a_517: loaded integer, a_518: loaded integer) =
          unseq(
            let weak (a_523: loaded integer, a_524: loaded integer) =
              unseq(
                let weak a_522: pointer = pure(i) in
                load('signed int', a_522)
              ,
                pure(Specified(5))
              ) in

                  pure(
                    if conv_int('signed int', a_525) <
                    conv_int('signed int', a_526) then
                      Specified(1)
                    else
                      Specified(0)
                  )
              | _: (loaded integer,loaded integer) =>
                  pure(Unspecified('signed int'))
            end

            pure(Specified(0))
          ) in

          case (a_517, a_518) of
            | (Specified(a_519: integer), Specified(a_520: integer)) =>
                if conv_int('signed int', a_519) = conv_int('signed int', a_520) then
                  Specified(1)
                else
                  Specified(0)
            | _: (loaded integer,loaded integer) =>
                Unspecified('signed int')
          end

    let strong a_514: boolean =
      case a_515 of
        | Specified(a_516: integer) =>
            pure(if not(a_516 = 1) then True else False)
        | Unspecified(_: ctype) =>
            nd(pure(True), pure(False))
      end in
    if a_514 then
      let strong _: loaded integer =
        bound(
          let weak (a_528: pointer, a_535: loaded integer) =
            unseq(
              pure(i)
            ,
              let weak (a_529: loaded integer, a_530: loaded integer) =

                case (a_529, a_530) of

          pure(conv_loaded_int('signed int', a_535))

    else
      pure(Unit) ;
  save break_511: unit (i: pointer:= i) in  pure(Unit) ;
  pure(Unit) ;
  let strong a_537: loaded integer =
    bound(
      let weak a_536: pointer = pure(i) in
      load('signed int', a_536)
    ) in

  run ret_509(conv_loaded_int('signed int', a_537)) ;
  kill('signed int', i) ;
  pure(Unit) ;
  save ret_509: loaded integer (a_538: loaded integer:= Specified(0)) in
    pure(a_538)
